title: What does one 250 g tin of Sencha cost you, delivered to your warehouse?
why: Every profit figure we show you starts from this cost. We can only estimate it from the three documents below, and a wrong cost makes good teas look bad and bad ones look good.

recommend.because: The three costs above add up to 4.20. It leaves out storage and your own time.

if_no: If 4.20 is not right, type the real cost. Until you confirm one, every profit figure is marked as an estimate.
